verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair axis for a commerce platform, but the pack never documents a way to define rules or handlers that run actions automatically when events occur. The only nearby items are a bare 'Webhook Events' pricing line, which belongs to a separate webhooks capability; generic 'own every commerce workflow' marketing; and 'Background workers' infrastructure. None of these show user-defined event rules, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
